clarification_requests_owner_or_team_pol.name: clarification_requests_owner_or_team_policy
clarification_requests_owner_or_team_pol.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = clarification_requests.project_id AND (p.client_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_team_members ptm WHERE ptm.project_id = p.id AND ptm.user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid)))

payments_target_check.name: payments_target_check
payments_target_check.value: ("payments"."contract_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payments"."building_permit_id" IS NOT NULL)

project_documents_owner_or_team_policy.name: project_documents_owner_or_team_policy
project_documents_owner_or_team_policy.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = project_documents.project_id AND (p.client_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_team_members ptm WHERE ptm.project_id = p.id AND ptm.user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid)))

professional_project_policy.name: professional_project_policy
professional_project_policy.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_team_members ptm WHERE ptm.project_id = projects.id AND ptm.user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid)
